name: Interest Payment Request V 05
definition: Scope|The InterestPaymentRequest message is sent by either;|- the collateral taker or its collateral manager to the collateral giver or its collateral manager, or|- the collateral giver or its collateral manager to the collateral taker or its collateral manager|It is used to request payment or advise the amount due for interest calculated for a specified period. The interest is based on the amount of collateral that has been held during the calculation period. It is possible to send these messages on a bi-lateral basis for matching.||The message definition is intended for use with the ISO20022 Business Application Header.||Usage|The InterestPaymentRequest message is used to advise the interest amount calculated for a specific period or request payment for an interest amount for a specific period.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as know by the instructing party.

Obligation.name: Obligation
Obligation.definition: Provides information like the identification of the party or parties associated with the collateral agreement, the exposure type and the valuation date.

Agreement.name: Agreement
Agreement.definition: Agreement details for the over the counter market.

InterestDueToA.name: Interest Due To A
InterestDueToA.definition: Provides details on the interest amount due to party A.

InterestDueToB.name: Interest Due To B
InterestDueToB.definition: Provides details on the interest amount due to party B.

NetAmountDetails.name: Net Amount Details
NetAmountDetails.definition: Provides the net interest amount due to A or due to B in case of collateral held and posted during a period.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
